notes: All values come from official primary sources (government documents, statistical communiqués and bulletins, ministry briefings), or from Xinhua/People's Daily reproductions of them (tagged medium). Figures published as floors (超过/以上) are shown with ≥. Secondary estimates (CAICT, trade press) appear only in notes. Cluster metrics are the latest official figures and mix scopes (city, hub, AI-only); coordinates are start-up-zone centroids.
